groups.saying_opens: مثل أبي زمعة عم الزبير بن العوام

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a): the khutba (saying 1) and «قال النبي ... مثل أبي زمعة» (saying 2, introduced by «وقال أبو معاوية»). Both are stored.
The Prophet's words are not a link; Abdullah b. Zam'a is the last link of each route.
